items.title: Google Quarterly Revenue Grows 25% But Falls Short of ExpectationsGoogle’s cloud sales surged in the latest quarter but overall revenue at parent Alphabet grew a slower-than-expected 25% to $127.6 billion, disappointing investors.  Operating profit rose in the third quarter, but net profit declined by nearly a quarter to $26.2 billion, well below analysts’ estimates according to S&P Capital IQ. Alphabet’s shares fell by nearly 9% in after hours trading.  Google Cloud revenue in the third quarter more than doubled from a year earlier to $30.7 billion, powered by demand from AI customers, the company said Wednesday. Sales of its tensor processing unit AI chips also meaningfully contributed to growth, it said.   The Information on Monday reported that Google had struck a deal to sell its TPUs to OpenAI—the same day Google announced a deal with Oracle for it to offer the AI chips. Last quarter, Google Chief Executive Sundar Pichai said that Google expects the “vast majority” of TPU revenues to be realized in 2027.  Google’s services business—its largest, which includes its core search advertising operation—grew less than 11% in the quarter, its slowest rate since the first quarter of last year.  Reflecting Google’s enormous spending on AI data centers, the company reported negative free cash flow of more than $9 billion. That marked its second straight quarter of negative cash flow, and was a big increase in the deficit from the negative $5.9 billion for the previous quarter.  Earlier today, Google released its latest model, Gemini 4 Carbon, which it said was significantly more capable than its previous model, Argon, released less than a month ago.

items.title_zh: 谷歌季度收入增长 25%，但未达预期谷歌最新季度的云销售额大幅增长，但母公司 Alphabet 的整体收入增长低于预期的 25%，至 1276 亿美元，令投资者感到失望。  第三季度营业利润增长，但净利润下降近四分之一至 262 亿美元，远低于 S&P Capital IQ 分析师的预期。 Alphabet 股价在盘后交易中下跌近 9%。  谷歌周三表示，受人工智能客户需求的推动，谷歌云第三季度收入同比增长一倍多，达到 307 亿美元。该公司表示，其张量处理单元人工智能芯片的销售也对增长做出了有意义的贡献。   The Information 周一报道称，谷歌已达成协议，将其 TPU 出售给 OpenAI——同一天，谷歌宣布与甲骨文达成协议，由其提供人工智能芯片。上个季度，谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊(Sundar Pichai)表示，谷歌预计“绝大多数”TPU收入将在2027年实现。谷歌最大的服务业务，包括其核心搜索广告业务，本季度增长不到11%，是去年第一季度以来的最低增速。  该公司公布的负自由现金流超过 90 亿美元，反映出谷歌在人工智能数据中心方面的巨额支出。这标志着连续第二个季度出现负现金流，赤字较上一季度的负 59 亿美元大幅增加。  今天早些时候，谷歌发布了其最新型号 Gemini 4 Carbon，据称该型号比不到一个月前发布的上一代型号 Argon 的功能要强大得多。
